turns.question: What's on this week in Wakefield?
turns.reply:
This week runs from Monday 9 November 2026 to Sunday 15 November 2026. Here’s what’s coming up from Sunday 15 November 2026.

My Eco Baby CIC Christmas Festival
WX Wakefield Exchange · Sunday 15 November 2026 · 10:00–15:00
[Event details](https://wxwakefield.co.uk/Whats-On/Details?event=eco-baby-christmas-festival)

Longer-running listings
These published runs overlap the period. Opening days and individual sessions are not confirmed, so check before planning a visit.

Inspired by Nature
Frickley Country Park · Ongoing until Wednesday 18 November 2026. Check the event page for individual session dates and times.
[Event details](https://experiencewakefield.co.uk/event/inspired-by-nature-frickley/)

Pontefract Ghost Walk
The Counting House Pontefract · Ongoing until Thursday 17 December 2026. Check the event page for individual session dates and times.
[Event details](https://experiencewakefield.co.uk/event/pontefract-ghost-walk/)

Pontefract Castle Explorer Tours
Pontefract Castle · Ongoing until Sunday 20 December 2026. Check the event page for individual session dates and times.
[Event details](https://experiencewakefield.co.uk/event/pontefract-castle-explorer-tours/)

This is a shortlist from the published listings I could check, so there may be others.
